text: I was thinking about the film night again last night, the one in the old hall with the broken projector. I don't know why it came back to me. Probably because I walked past the cinema on Kadıköy yesterday and it's a bank now, or it will be soon, and I realised I couldn't remember what we actually watched. Hababam Sınıfı, I'm fairly sure, but I might be mixing it up with the sequel. What I do remember is the bulb going during the second reel, and Mr Akın standing up at the front and saying the lesson was the same, only darker, and the whole hall laughing for a full minute before anyone could sit down again. You were in the row in front of me with that green scarf. You kept turning round to see if I was still laughing. I think that was the first time I thought you'd be somebody I knew for a long time. Anyway. I wanted to ask whether you remember it the same way or whether I've made it up.
